majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for general education teachers, substitutes, classroom instructional supplies, textbooks, digital learning licenses, and classroom tech across all 18 schools.
State Health Benefits Program (SEHBP) medical and prescription coverage, dental insurance, employer FICA/Social Security, workers' compensation, and statutory teacher pension allocations.
Special education teacher salaries, one-on-one paraprofessionals, speech therapy, occupational therapy, and mandated specialized program materials.
Mandated tuition paid to Passaic County Technical Institute (PCTI/PCTVS), specialized private schools for students with severe disabilities, and county special services.
Custodial staff, maintenance workers, natural gas, electricity, water/sewer, security guards/officers, building repairs, HVAC filter maintenance, and grounds care.
Contracted bus routes to and from district schools, out-of-district specialized transit, athletic and field trip transit, bus aides, and fuel.
Salaries for 18 school principals, assistant principals, and school clerical office secretaries.
Superintendent's office, Business Administrator/Board Secretary, human resources, district legal counsel, external financial auditor, and public notices.
Instructional coaches, media specialists, professional development, curriculum development, and library books.

majorAppropriations.category: Mandated Charter School Tuition Transfers (Classical Academy & Regional Charters)
majorAppropriations.details: Statutory local tax transfer mandated by the State of New Jersey for Clifton resident students attending public charter schools (including Classical Academy Charter School of Clifton on Main Ave and regional charter schools).

majorAppropriations.category: Voter-Approved $168M Facilities Bond Referendum Debt Service
majorAppropriations.details: Principal and interest debt service on the historic $168.4M voter-approved school facilities bond referendum (offset by ~$64.6M in NJ State Debt Service Aid) funding HVAC, roofs, ADA accessibility, security vestibules, and the Woodrow Wilson MS athletic complex across 19 school facilities.
